authority.rule: The model proposes meaning and typed relations; deterministic runtime validates and freezes one contract. Context projections provide evidence but never select a target.

current_user_authority.source: latest HumanMessage of the current TurnRequest
current_user_authority.literal_span_rule: Every evidence_span and domain-neutral *_span must be a contiguous literal substring of the current user message.
current_user_authority.history_rule: Historical assistant text, tool diagnostics, audit summaries and model paraphrases cannot become current-turn literal evidence.
current_user_authority.history_reference_rule: History may contribute only scoped opaque result references, typed lineage, prior GoalRecords and explicit user-visible answer evidence.

frozen_semantic_contract.failure_rule: Capability absence, tool rejection, plan failure or business failure may update progress/outcomes but may not rewrite requested_effect or user meaning.

typed_target_set.authority_location: Each Goal target_candidate/input_candidates inside the frozen TurnSemanticContract and its validated GoalRecord revision.
required_properties: typed operation or exact opaque handle
no implicit capability or business-state claim
typed_target_set.ambiguity_rule: When more than one source-bound interpretation remains, the semantic result is CLARIFY; runtime cannot choose the latest or most similar object.
typed_target_set.same_effect_scope_rule: Multiple latest-visible references produced by the same verified source_effect_id may form one discourse scope; latest references from distinct source_effect_id values remain distinct and a singular reference is ambiguous.
typed_target_set.correction_rule: A correction must use explicit goal change, supersede or typed target patch with current revision and current-turn literal evidence.
typed_target_set.requested_effect_change_rule: Changing requested_effect creates a new Goal and supersedes the old Goal; PATCH_GOAL cannot silently change the business effect.

components: execution diagnostics isolated from semantic facts
audit index available only for explicit audit inspection
context_evidence_projection.rebuild_rule: The projection may be rebuilt for later model calls, but once the semantic contract is frozen it cannot mutate or replace the contract.
context_evidence_projection.availability_rule: Expired, unavailable, out-of-scope or never-released result references are omitted or rejected; they are not repaired through guessing.

visible_result_ref.meaning: Evidence that a scoped ledger result crossed the customer-visible release boundary.
visible_result_ref.member_rule: An exact member handle may be validated only through membership in a released collection; runtime never chooses the member.
visible_result_ref.lineage_rule: Derived collection lineage may support typed set relations, but cannot select an unrelated topic.

visible_referent_sets.prohibition: A referent-set identifier cannot be passed directly as a business target.

goal_and_focus_lifecycle.goal_record_authority: semantic goal lifecycle not business fact
goal_and_focus_lifecycle.revision_rule: Every change binds current revision and next revision.
goal_and_focus_lifecycle.focus_rule: focus_state is a revisioned UI/orchestration projection and never semantic or target authority.
goal_and_focus_lifecycle.blocker_rule: Clarification blockers are Goal-scoped and may coexist; one blocker does not force one global turn disposition.

separation_boundaries.wp02a: WP-02B cannot create, claim, replay or complete client_request_id/TurnRequestLedger records.
separation_boundaries.wp03: WP-02B declares the requested effect even when unsupported; only CapabilitySurface+MatchProof may prove support or absence.
separation_boundaries.wp04: Planning derives from the frozen contract and cannot reinterpret it.
separation_boundaries.wp05: Semantic targets and GoalRecords are not business facts or transaction states.
separation_boundaries.wp06: Response projection cannot synthesize a new semantic decision.

allowed: legacy goal_type retained only inside compatibility metadata
legacy checkpoints migrated before canonical context projections
historical plan/category data read only by explicit migration adapters
forbidden: free-text history scan used as a business target
legacy goal_type affecting newly frozen semantic identity

exit_conditions: one frozen semantic contract owns current-turn meaning and typed goals
context evidence is projected before freeze and remains non-selecting
all target/reference operations are typed, source-bound and runtime-validated
ambiguous references fail closed to Goal-scoped clarification
no active keyword, intent, latest-object or per-tool context authority remains
all acceptance tests plus complete regression pass
